text:
Sam: FYI canary for search-service-prod (release/2026.03.21) got auto-paused by deploy-bot during post-upgrade hooks — values overlay checksum mismatch for tenant-acme.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary paused for HelmRelease "search-service-prod" stage=postupgrade-hooks. Reason: values-checksum mismatch (expected=0x7a9f4, actual=0xb2c1d). Action: annotate helmrelease with release.redwood/resume=true or push a values pin commit.
Talia: Is this a chart change or overlay drift? Chart bumped to v2.4.1 this morning.
Jordan: Looks like overlay drift. tenant-acme overlay enables scale-to-zero via hpa.minReplicas=0 which breaks the postupgrade job (job waits for pods). I can push a quick overlay patch to force minReplicas=1.
Maria: Please grab the postupgrade job logs first so we have evidence for release notes.
Code block (Jordan):
```
kubectl logs job/postupgrade-search-1832 -n prod
# shows: waiting for 0 ready pods, timeout after 5m
```
Jordan: Plan A: commit overlay patch (set tenants.acme.hpa.minReplicas=1) -> pipeline will redeploy canary. Plan B (ops shortcut): annotate to resume and patch later. Prefer Plan A for reproducibility.
Talia: We're inside the payments change window (03:30-05:30 UTC). Any rollback would be noisy. Can we get a 15m extension to finish? @Release Manager
Release Manager: Approve +15m extension for this canary only. Keep notes minimal and add a delta to release tracker.
Jordan: Pushed commit 6d4e2a9 to overlays/tenant-acme. Kicking pipeline now. Helm output:
```
Upgrading release search-service-prod
postupgrade job completed
new pod(s) ready: 1
Canary progressing
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary resumed. Progressed: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Health: passing. Metrics: p95 latency and CPU within SLO for 10m.
Maria: Adding to release notes: "Fix: tenant overlay HPA prevented postupgrade pods from stabilizing; pinned minReplicas=1 for tenant-acme."
Talia: Decision: do not rollback. We'll pin chart@v2.4.1 and record values-hash=0xb2c1d in the release manifest to prevent automated flips if overlays drifted again.
Sam: I've annotated the HelmRelease with release.redwood/resume=true and added a comment on the release tracker with pipeline run link.
Leo: Follow-up assigned to SRE: run a short audit script across overlays to detect any hpa.minReplicas=0 entries and open PRs for tenants that shouldn't scale-to-zero during hooks.
Jordan: Created a short ops runbook entry about avoiding scale-to-zero during post-upgrade hooks and added the PR link.
Sam: Closing thread. Canary healthy after ~12m, no rollback. :thumbsup:
